subject: Pricing for 40 lb/week
body:
Hi Maya,

We loved the House Blend samples. The team voted and we'd like to move Bloom to Ember & Oak starting the week of Nov 16.

We'd need about 40 lb a week: roughly 30 lb House Blend for drip and 10 lb Oak Street Espresso. Could you send your wholesale pricing at that volume, delivery days, and payment terms? Our current roaster is at $11.20/lb delivered, so that's the number I have to beat with my partners.

Also, could we taste the new Guji Natural before Friday? I'd love to have it as a guest pour-over the launch weekend. Thursday's tasting at 10:30 still works on our side.

Thanks!
Lena Ortiz
Owner, Bloom Café · 2210 SE Division St

subject: Following up: a few numbers before Thursday
body:
Hi Maya,

Really enjoyed meeting you at the Portland Founders breakfast. Before we sit down Thursday, could you send a few numbers so I can come prepared?

1. Monthly revenue for the last 3 months, split web / wholesale / café
2. Gross margin on a 12 oz bag
3. Number of active subscriptions and monthly churn
4. How many wholesale accounts you have, and the pipeline

No deck needed, a short email is perfect. I'm mostly trying to understand how fast wholesale can grow without a second roaster.

Best,
Daniel Okafor
Partner, Cascade Seed Partners

subject: Invoice HGI-20931: green coffee, due Nov 19
body:
Hello Ember & Oak,

Please find your invoice for the shipment delivered Oct 30 to 1418 SE Belmont St.

Invoice HGI-20931 · Terms: Net 20 · Due: Nov 19, 2026

- Ethiopia Guji Natural, Grade 1 (Hambela): 4 bags × 60 kg = 240 kg @ $8.90/kg: $2,136.00
- Colombia Huila Washed, Excelso: 2 bags × 70 kg = 140 kg @ $7.40/kg: $1,036.00
- Freight & warehouse handling: $185.00

Total due: $3,357.00

Pay by ACH to the account on file, or by card (3% fee). Your next Huila allocation can ship Nov 12 if confirmed by Nov 6.

Thank you,
Accounts, Highland Green Imports

subject: Order #EO-4471 arrived late and stale
body:
Hi,

I ordered two bags of House Blend on Oct 24 (order #EO-4471) as a birthday gift for my dad. The tracking said Oct 28. They arrived Nov 2, and one bag says roasted Oct 14. It tasted flat and papery, nothing like what I had at your café.

I've been a fan for a year and I'm honestly disappointed. The birthday was Oct 30, so the timing was a miss too.

I'd like a refund for the stale bag at least ($17). Not trying to be difficult, just want to know what happened.

Tom Becker

subject: Podcast invite: Small Batch Radio
body:
Hi Maya,

I host Small Batch Radio, a weekly podcast about independent food makers (about 18,000 listeners, mostly home cooks and home brewers on the West Coast).

I'd love to have you on to talk about starting Ember & Oak, sourcing directly from producers, and what it's like launching a new coffee. Recording is remote, 45 minutes. I have two slots open: Thu Nov 12 at 2:00 PM or Fri Nov 13 at 11:00 AM Pacific.

If the Guji Natural is out by then, we could even do a little tasting segment if you mail us a bag.

Warmly,
Ana Lima
Host, Small Batch Radio

subject: Saturday load-in + holiday market dates
body:
Hi vendors,

Quick reminders for Saturday Nov 7: load-in from 7:00 AM, booths must be set by 7:50. Ember & Oak is in booth 14 again.

Holiday markets are confirmed for Dec 5, 12 and 19, 9 AM to 3 PM, with about twice our usual foot traffic. Stall fee is $85 per day. Returning vendors get first pick, but I need your dates by Nov 10.

Also, a heads up: the market Wi-Fi will be down on Saturday for maintenance. Please make sure your card readers work offline or on cellular.

Thanks,
Rita Gomez
Market Manager

subject: Delay on your Guji Natural printed bags
body:
Hi Maya,

Sorry to bring bad news. Our foil press went down Monday and your order of 500 printed 12 oz Guji Natural bags (PO 7713) is now finishing Thursday. Standard ground freight would get them to you Friday around 2 PM, which I know is after your launch morning.

Two options:
1. Air expedite for $140 and we deliver Thursday by 5 PM.
2. We ship you 200 blank kraft bags today at no charge, and you use your launch stickers for Friday's first orders.

Let me know by 3 PM today so I can book the courier. We're on a call at 1 PM anyway.

Owen Hart
Account Manager, Northline Packaging

subject: Huila is running low
body:
Hey Maya,

Heads up: the newsletter link sent a lot of people to Huila yesterday. We're down to 24 roasted 12 oz bags and only one roast's worth of green left (about 30 kg). At this pace we're out by Friday, right when everyone is on the site for the Guji launch.

Highland Green can ship a new Huila allocation Nov 12 if we confirm by Friday. Want me to confirm 2 bags? Also: should we pause Huila on the site or add a "back soon" note?

Bloom Café math is on my side, I'll have the margin sheet ready before Thursday.

Priya

subject: Can I preorder the Guji for a gift?
body:
Hi Ember & Oak!

I saw the newsletter about the new Ethiopian coffee on Friday. My partner is obsessed with fruity naturals, and our anniversary is Nov 8. Is there any way to preorder two bags so they ship on launch day? Happy to pay now.

Also, do you do gift notes? Something short like "Happy 5 years, H." would be perfect.

Thank you so much, your Huila is our everyday coffee.

Hannah

subject: Launch post + photos for Friday
body:
Hi Maya!

For Friday I'm thinking: one Instagram carousel at 8 AM (bag, the cup, a shot of the cherries from the Hambela photos the producer sent), then the Live at noon. Caption should lead with the tasting notes and the producer story, and mention it's limited to about 500 bags.

Problem: we don't have a proper product shot of the new bag, and the printed bags may not even be here (saw Owen's email). Can you approve a caption by Thursday night? I'll schedule it.

Also we hit 4,200 followers this week.

Jules
